notes: Side effect outside the issue's scope: without codehilite, `hl_lines="1 2"` used to produce the attribute `hl_lines="[1, 2]"` (a stringified Python list) and is now dropped. The filter drops any value that isn't a string, so this follows from it. The new behaviour is arguably better, but neither the changelog nor a test mentions it.
Changelog: the new entry is followed by a blank line before the existing bullets, so this section's list is split in two. This is cosmetic.
Pygments is not installed in this environment, so codehilite ran without Pygments. The code path with codehilite enabled is unchanged by the diff anyway.
I could not compare against the base commit through git because the hook blocks it. Instead I made a copy of the package with the one-line filter removed and used it as the baseline.
summary: The fix is a small, targeted change. In the branch without codehilite, `fenced_code` now emits only string-valued config entries as attributes, so boolean or None values from Pygments options (`linenums`, `guess_lang`, `noclasses`, also `linenums="false"`) no longer make serialization raise TypeError. String attributes such as data-x and linenostart are still emitted, and output with codehilite enabled is unchanged. The new tests fail with TypeError when the fix is removed and pass with it, and the full suite passes. There is a changelog entry. I found no blocking problems.
